messages:
Ana (Design): quick thought — the mini-stream handoff feels jerky when a user hits Stop then Regenerate quickly. we should decide if stop should cancel inflight tokens or let the stream finish the current chunk before freezing.
Mike (PM): agree. current behavior cancels immediately which saves tokens but the UI jump is noisy. what do we trade for smoother UX?
Taylor (Eng): cancelling early is easiest on infra (drops KV state) but makes prompt re-run tricky because partial KV remains. we can flush cache on stop but cost rises.
Jamal (DevEx): from user perspective, a short graceful finish (100–200ms) + subtle crossfade feels good. maybe show "Finishing" micro-state in the mini toolbar.
Lina (A11y): if we add a micro-state, ensure screen readers announce it, e.g., "Stream finishing" role=status. also keep focus order stable — don't reflow controls.
Ana (Design): mockup suggestion: replace instant disappear with a 3-step microflow: Streaming -> Finishing (faint spinner) -> Stopped. token meter freezes at final count. small label: "finalizing..."
Mike (PM): how about Regenerate during Finishing? should it queue or cancel? my vote: Regenerate should cancel and start fresh to match user intent.
Taylor (Eng): implementable: on Stop set state=FINISHING for 150ms; regenerate triggers immediate abort + new request. can add debounce to prevent double hits.
Jamal (DevEx): also think about prompt library quick-insert while stream active — currently it inserts then the live stream stomps the input. need guard: when insert happens, focus should go to composer and stream should not hijack.
Ana (Design): yep — when user inserts from prompt library, show tiny toast: "Inserted into composer" and keep composer focused. avoid auto-send.
Lina (A11y): toast must be accessible: role=alert and dismissible by keyboard. color contrast for the micro-toast is low on current mocks.
Taylor (Eng): technical nit: token meter updates are high-frequency. we should throttle to 50ms to avoid paint churn on low-power devices.
Mike (PM): notes for copy: change "Stop" tooltip to "Stop generation (freestyle stop)"? maybe too wordy. suggestions?
Ana (Design): shorter: "Stop generation" and hover hint: "Hold to cancel remaining tokens" — but avoid relying on hold.
Jamal (DevEx): add shortcut hints: Esc = stop, Shift+Enter = regen? put that in mini-help under the composer.
Lina (A11y): ensure keyboard users can access stop/regenerate tab order after stream starts. test with VoiceOver + NVDA.
Taylor (Eng): I'll prototype FINISHING state + 150ms crossfade and throttle token meter. aiming PR by EOD Friday.
Ana (Design): I'll update Figma with the micro-toast, finishing state label, and updated tooltips.
Mike (PM): great. can we ship this as an A/B where 50% get FINISHING vs current immediate-cancel behavior so we can measure signal: session interruption, regen rate, and perception NPS?
Jamal (DevEx): yes, add telemetry events: stream_stop_immediate vs stream_stop_finish, regen_after_stop, prompt_insert_during_stream.
Taylor (Eng): noted. I'll add flags: feature.finish-stop and telemetry hooks.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued for experiment flags after code review. :rocket:
Ana (Design): follow-ups: Lina can you run a quick keyboard/voiceover pass on mock? Jamal can you draft the telemetry names?
Lina (A11y): will do a pass tomorrow morning.
Jamal (DevEx): drafting telemetry now, will post a short schema in #eng-infra.
Mike (PM): OK closing loop — thanks everyone. will track metrics in the console once experiments are up. :tada:
